verses.en: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.pt: Tributai ao Senhor, ó filhos dos poderosos, tributai ao Senhor glória e força.
verses.en_web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> Give to the Lord, you sons of the gods, give to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
verses.pt: Tributai ao Senhor a glória devida ao seu nome; adorai o Senhor vestidos de trajes santos.
verses.en_web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
verses.en_bbe: Give to the Lord the full glory of his name; give him worship in holy robes.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor ouve-se sobre as águas; o Deus da glória troveja; o Senhor está sobre as muitas águas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of the Lord is on the waters: the God of glory is thundering, the Lord is on the great waters.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor é poderosa; a voz do Senhor é cheia de majestade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of the Lord is full of power; the voice of the Lord has a noble sound.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor quebra os cedros; sim, o Senhor quebra os cedros do Líbano.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: By the voice of the Lord are the cedar-trees broken, even the cedars of Lebanon are broken by the Lord.

verses.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.pt: Ele faz o Líbano saltar como um bezerro; e Siriom, como um filhote de boi selvagem.
verses.en_web: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
verses.en_bbe: He makes them go jumping about like a young ox; Lebanon and Sirion like a young mountain ox.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor lança labaredas de fogo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.en_bbe: At the voice of the Lord flames of fire are seen.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor faz tremer o deserto; o Senhor faz tremer o deserto de Cades.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.en_bbe: At the voice of the Lord there is a shaking in the waste land, even a shaking in the waste land of Kadesh.

verses.en: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.pt: A voz do Senhor faz as corças dar à luz, e desnuda as florestas; e no seu templo todos dizem: Glória!
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”
verses.en_bbe: At the voice of the Lord the roes give birth, the leaves are taken from the trees: in his Temple everything says, Glory.

verses.en: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
verses.pt: O Senhor está entronizado sobre o dilúvio; o Senhor se assenta como rei, perpetuamente.
verses.en_web: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord had his seat as king when the waters came on the earth; the Lord is seated as king for ever.

verses.en: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
verses.pt: O Senhor dará força ao seu povo; o Senhor abençoará o seu povo com paz.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will give his people the blessing of peace.
